items.text:
Written after calming down this time...

The game has potential. It's unpolished and liable to frustrate you to the point of quitting with or without bugs, though game-breaking bugs are kind of a save killer. The music is great, fun to listen to while watching your crew working. Most challenges can be overcome with time and patience, and most deaths feel like it is your own fault. 

However, there are definitely a few things that need to be fixed before I can recommend this to anyone but the most patient gamers, and they are not minor issues. 

First and foremost, the authority ships. I don't dislike the idea of authority ships chasing you to fine you or arrest you. That's a wonderful mechanic idea. The issue is how often they just flat out crash into you and ruin most of your ship. It's been a recurring enough issue to cause dozens of reloads and a few new games.

Second, the crew. Once again, I love the concept. However...unless I am just making mistakes, then it is nearly impossible to even keep a single crew member with you for any length of time. I don't mean they leave after one mission. I mean they leave the ship, saying they quit and don't want to join anymore immediately after joining.

Next is...I suppose either a glitch or some kind of issue that I'm not aware of. I spent hours (real time) retrofitting a ship that I found to make into my new ship, and it was going well. Time consuming, but well. Last night, I looked over the entire ship and found nothing wrong. Power working throughout the ship, new additions added on and most of my ship equipment now in the new ship. I save, go to bed, and get back on first thing in the morning. The ship somehow has four broken wall tiles that are now letting out all the heat and oxygen that took me hours to get stable. 

Beyond that, I hope to see improvements to this. I am glad that this is early access, because it shows. Rough, unpolished (so far), but with potential. However, I can not recommend this AS OF NOW. This could easily become a thumbs up with a few bug fixes, tweaks, and additional content. What that content would be, I can take a few guesses and have a few hopes.

6/10 for the end result. 9/10 for the concept. 10/10 for music and writing, even with a few very minor typos in select scenes.
items.text_zh:
这次冷静下来后写的……

这游戏有潜力。它未经打磨，无论有没有bug都可能让你沮丧到想退出，不过那些破坏游戏的bug算是存档杀手。音乐很棒，看着你的船员工作时听很享受。大多数挑战都能靠时间和耐心克服，大多数死亡感觉都是你自己的错。

然而，在我能向除了最有耐心的玩家之外的任何人推荐这款游戏之前，肯定有几件事需要修复，而且它们不是小问题。

首先也是最重要的，是权威飞船。我并不讨厌权威飞船追着你罚款或逮捕你的想法。那是个绝妙的机制点子。问题在于它们经常直接撞上你，毁掉你大部分飞船。这已经是个反复出现的问题，导致了几十次读档和几次重开新游戏。

第二，船员。再一次，我喜欢这个概念。然而……除非我只是在犯错，否则几乎不可能让哪怕一个船员在你身边待上任何一段时间。我不是说他们执行一次任务后就离开。我是说他们离开飞船，说他们不干了，而且刚加入就立刻不想再加入了。

接下来是……我想要么是个故障，要么是某种我不知道的问题。我花了几个小时（现实时间）改装一艘我找到的飞船，想把它变成我的新飞船，进展顺利。很耗时，但顺利。昨晚，我检查了整艘飞船，没发现任何问题。电力在全船正常工作，新添加的部分加上了，我的大部分飞船设备现在都在新飞船里。我保存，去睡觉，早上一起来就重新上线。飞船不知怎么有了四块破损的墙板，现在正把花了我几个小时才稳定下来的热量和氧气全都漏出去。

除此之外，我希望看到这方面的改进。我很高兴这是抢先体验，因为这一点很明显。粗糙、未经打磨（到目前为止），但有潜力。然而，就目前而言，我不能推荐这款游戏。只要修几个bug、做些调整并增加额外内容，这很容易就能变成好评。至于那内容会是什么，我可以猜几个，也有几个希望。

最终结果6/10。概念9/10。音乐和文本10/10，即使某些场景里有几个非常小的错别字。
